notes: Researched as the manufacturer's rack-mount Jellyfish (OWC's own site copy literally reads "OWC Jellyfish Rack is the preferred solution for ultra-high-bandwidth connectivity..."), officially SKU'd as "Jellyfish R24" (24-bay, 144TB-432TB raw, dual Xeon Silver, 512GB ECC RAM, ZFS RAID-Z2, 4U rackmount, hot-swap redundant 875W PSUs). Primary source: manufacturer product/spec page https://www.owc.com/solutions/jellyfish/r24 ("Deep Specs" section), cross-checked against B&H Photo listing for the same SKU (JFR240144) which corroborates 4U form factor, dual 875W redundant PSU, and dual 1GbE RJ45 base networking. Ports listed reflect the BASE configuration only. OWC sells field-upgradable network modules not included as fixed ports here: 10GbE (RJ45 or SFP+), 25GbE (QSFP), 50GbE (QSFP28), or 100GbE (QSFP28), scaling up to a stated maximum of 16 total direct-connect network ports — these are build-to-order options, not standard I/O, so grades for them were not assigned. The rear-panel 12G Mini-SAS HD (SFF-8644) port used to daisy-chain up to four Jellyfish R24-E expansion chassis has no matching connector id in the allowed connector list and was therefore omitted from the ports array rather than mis-mapped. IPMI port presence/speed and the AC inlet connector type are reasonable inferences for this class of dual-Xeon rackmount server rather than values OWC states explicitly per-connector, hence overall confidence is medium rather than high.

ports.name: IPMI
ports.note: Dedicated server management (BMC) LAN port, listed by OWC under "Additional Server Access"; assumed 1GbE and physically separate from the two data NICs, consistent with the dual-Xeon server chassis this unit is built on.

ports.name: VGA
ports.note: Local console video output, listed under "Additional Server Access".

ports.name: USB 3 Port 1
ports.note: OWC lists these only as "USB 3"; generation (3.0 vs 3.1/3.2) not specified, so baseline USB 3.0 (5Gbps) assumed.

ports.name: AC In 1
ports.note: One of two redundant 875W hot-swap PSU modules. OWC does not itemize the inlet connector; IEC C13/C14 assumed as typical for this PSU wattage/class.

ports.name: AC In 2
ports.note: Second of two redundant 875W hot-swap PSU modules; same assumption as AC In 1.
